study: R158 single bounded development revision after evaluating the first replacement on this same ordinary cohort
scope: 1,798 registered R145 EXT records, same six directions, immutable A boxes and sampled-A PCA
reason: Role-phrase voting degraded the original reader. Removing the separate subject phrase recovered performance; overlap-based decisions and correctly directed explicit A-camera layout showed signal. Permuted reference evidence did not underperform correctly assigned reference evidence.
change: Use two complete-sentence likelihoods: the intact learned competition distribution in the original registered readout and the native full-sentence literal-target token distribution at A anchors (B max contribution 0.5 times per-box registered coverage). Normalize both and take their equal-weight geometric mean. Apply only explicit A-camera target layout; compensate duplicate boxes by sum of squared overlaps and choose the candidate with the largest posterior expected pairwise 3D overlap. No separate phrase or custom reference marginal affects the revision. Both A-only and A+B use this same decision.
controls: old scores plus same overlap decoder
revision argmax of semantic logits before overlap
adoption: Retain as working replacement only if development six-direction design-weighted mIoU beats original joint_zero and old_scores_risk. Equal weights fixed. Publish all directions, both B strata and failures. No further coefficient selection from this cohort.
